positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Meta Reality Labs (Oculus)
- Led development of the new user experience for Eye Calibration in the Quest Pro
- Built new user experiences for Quest and Quest 2 in VR
- Helped create flows for merging FB + Oculus accounts in the Oculus mobile app

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Instagram Notifications
- Platformized notification development across multiple code stacks within FB+IG to increase developer efficiency
- Ran growth experiments on notifications across IG

Instagram Content Signal Platform Team
- Created a service that compares real-time and offline scores for Instagram content to serve as guiderails against score/model degradation

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Developed features as part of the Activity and Exercise Team that would aid users in living a healthier lifestyle

Worked on backend production code and created new API endpoints that are pivotal for the release of upcoming products

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Optimized backend of production code by incorporating integrated downloads of Vimeo video URLs.

Updated database to include GeoLite2 data (using Powershell for scripting) and created measures to counteract cheating by utilizing distance algorithms on the GeoLite2 information of users extracted from their login IP addresses.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Part-time software engineering intern with Cambridge-based startup focused on mobile applications for the hospitality industry.

Assist with optimizing the product’s backend (utilizing Ruby on Rails) and Python scripts that extract information, such as room service options, from hotel web pages

positions.title: CS50 Course Assistant
positions.description: •	One of ~25 undergraduate course assistants in 875 student lecture, providing assistance on introductory programming concepts and guidance on weekly problem sets

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: Developed a web application utilizing JavaScript (node.js, angular.js, and express) and MongoDB that allows users to build collaborative journals and travel logs

positions.title: Neurovascular Research Intern
positions.description: Created a prediction model for parenchymal hematoma, and compared the efficiencies of three imaging techniques for the prediction of parenchymal hematoma
